docs.title: Celestia-IoT
docs.text:
A small open-source space and environmental data station.

Celestia-IoT is a desktop device based on ESP32 that combines:

  • environmental sensors
  • space data
  • ISS pass information
  • OLED interface
  • Wi-Fi connectivity
  • data engineering pipelines
  • analytics and machine learning

docs.title: Project goals
docs.text: The project combines embedded systems, data engineering and data science.
